description: This file defines internal syscall handling APIs for Zephyr OS, including functions and macros for validating kernel objects, managing permissions, and handling user space memory checks in the context of system calls.

methods.name: k_is_in_user_syscall
methods.description: Checks if the current context is handling a user mode system call.

methods.name: k_object_validate
methods.description: Validates a kernel object pointer for type, permissions, and initialization state.

methods.name: k_object_dump_error
methods.description: Outputs error information for failed object validation.

methods.name: k_object_find
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a given kernel object pointer.

methods.name: k_object_wordlist_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all kernel object metadata in the system.

methods.name: k_thread_perms_inherit
methods.description: Copies permissions from a parent thread to a child thread.

methods.name: k_thread_perms_set
methods.description: Grants a thread permission to a kernel object.

methods.name: k_thread_perms_clear
methods.description: Revokes a thread permission to a kernel object.

methods.name: k_thread_perms_all_clear
methods.description: Revokes all object permissions for a thread.

methods.name: k_object_uninit
methods.description: Clears the initialization state of a kernel object.

methods.name: k_object_recycle
methods.description: Resets permissions and marks a kernel object as initialized.

methods.name: k_usermode_string_nlen
methods.description: Gets the length of a user space string safely.

methods.name: k_usermode_alloc_from_copy
methods.description: Allocates and copies data from user space.

methods.name: k_usermode_from_copy
methods.description: Copies data from user space to kernel space with checks.

methods.name: k_usermode_to_copy
methods.description: Copies data from kernel space to user space with checks.

methods.name: k_usermode_string_alloc_copy
methods.description: Duplicates a user space string into kernel resource pool.

methods.name: k_usermode_string_copy
methods.description: Copies a user space string into a kernel buffer.
